candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Fully accurate text including 「Nとは反対に」. Blockquote is a reasonable representation of the boxed 接続の形 section; leading full-width space of paragraph preserved.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Error: 「Nと反対に」 should be 「Nとは反対に」 (dropped は). Box rendered only as bold text, losing the boxed layout; paragraph indent dropped.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Text fully accurate. Uses a two-column table (with empty header row) to represent the box — slightly awkward but conveys the enclosed layout; paragraph indent preserved.

rationale: A and C both transcribe every character correctly, including the crucial 「Nとは反対に」. A edges out C because its blockquote is a cleaner, more natural markdown analogue of the boxed rule than C's oddly structured table. B is last due to a genuine character error (dropping は in 「Nとは反対に」) and weaker representation of the box (plain bold text).
